use IO.Std.write
use IO.Std.write_line

floyd(rows: int) is
    let last_row_first = rows * (rows - 1) / 2 + 1
    let value mut = 1

    for row in 1::rows do
        for column in 1::row do
            if column > 1 then
                write(" ")
            fi

            let width = "{last_row_first + column - 1}".length

            write("{value}".pad_left(width))

            value = value + 1
        od

        write_line()
    od
si

floyd(5)
write_line()
